usedFor: Webshipper holds orders, shipments and returns, and viaSocket utilities adds a wait with “Pause Workflow” after “New Order”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Order” in Webshipper, then “Pause Workflow” in viaSocket utilities
bestTemplate.why: It holds the flow for X minutes after an order arrives, so later steps wait their turn.

watchOut: “Order Updated” also fires in Webshipper, so the same order can reach “Pause Workflow” again and start a second wait.
